transitions.historical_text: Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field. Select 1 Insect-Type monster from your Deck that is 1 Level higher than the Tributed monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. Then shuffle your Deck.
transitions.modern_text: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster from your Deck whose Level is 1 higher than the Tributed monster's.
transitions.summary: Functional text erratum: the pre-RP02 text summons the searched Insect in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position, and the GOAT script implements that position mask. RP02 drops the clause and the modern script summons face-up only, so the era card can Set the Deck monster face-down while the modern card cannot.

transitions.summary: Failed-search verification, separate from activation legality: when the GOAT search finds no eligible Insect, the script reveals the Deck with `Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)`; the modern script does not. The card-specific application is an implementation-backed inference from the same Deck-search procedure documented in the period rulings; no source located establishes that this transition co-occurred with the activation-legality change.

coverage.gap_reason: Project Ignis ships no implementation matching the RP02 text while retaining the historical activation and failed-search verification package; reproducing this intermediate state needs a custom script and reserved passcode.

gap.behavioural_impact: Period ruling package on top of the text change. Activation condition: the modern `s.cfilter` (the release-cost filter) also requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,lv+1,e,tp)`, while the goat cfilter drops it, so the Tribute can be paid with no Insect of the right Level in the Deck. Failed-search verification: the goat operation adds `else Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)`. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so this change is left unresolved.

review.notes: Adjudicated v2 model: the 2009 RP02 position/text change, the per-card activation-legality change, and the failed-search Deck-verification procedure are three separate behavioral events. The GOAT implementation contains both historical ruling behaviors, but implementation co-occurrence is not historical co-occurrence evidence; no source found establishes that the activation and verification changes occurred together or in either order. The RP02 position event is date-proven before the bounded verification event (2009-07-24 before the last old attestation on 2011-02-02), while activation remains undated and unordered. The old implementation is preserved at {}, and the RP02-only state is an explicit known gap; all other newly reachable nonterminal combinations remain mechanically UNRESOLVED.
